meta.title: Epispace — Local marketing people can see, scan, and step into
meta.description: Local places lose foot traffic to screens. Epispace turns short-form video, street WebAR, and character IP into one marketing firm — built from live projects in Jeju and Vancouver.
meta.ogImageAlt: Epispace — local marketing people can see, scan, and step into

hero.headline: Your street is open. Nobody stops.
hero.sub: Ads scroll past. Foot traffic thins. Epispace fixes that with marketing people can watch, scan on the spot, and walk into — built from real projects, not a pitch deck.
hero.caption: Lee Jung-seob Street, Seogwipo
hero.alt: A person holding a phone up in front of Lee Jung-seob’s room in Seogwipo

painLead: Commercial streets, festivals, and local brands share the same hole.

pain.title: Online never reaches the door.
pain.body: Reels and ads get views. The plaza stays quiet. There is no bridge from the phone to the street.

pain.title: The place has a story. Nothing shows it.
pain.body: History, makers, and seasonal events stay on signs people walk past. No reason to linger.

pain.title: One campaign dies when the budget ends.
pain.body: A poster run or a hired film leaves nothing ownable. Next season starts from zero.

firmHeading: Those pieces gathered into a firm.
firmLead: Not three separate services. One stack: get people to stop online, bring them to the street, leave a face that stays.

firm.title: Video that makes people stop — and visit.
firm.body: Creator-led short-form (Reels · TikTok · Shorts) that turns a local place into a discovery. From field shoots in Seogwipo to Vancouver brand reels with tens of thousands of organic views.
firm.from: Grew from festival films and on-street shoots
firm.alt: On-street filming for a local activation

firm.title: The street tells its story. No app.
firm.body: WebAR trails and photo zones in the browser. Scan NFC or QR at the spot — the hidden story appears. Built for plazas, shopping streets, and festival sites.
firm.from: Grew from museum NFC, cherry blossom, virtual OOH, rain
firm.alt: WebAR screens from the Lee Jung-seob Street trail

firm.title: A character that outlives the campaign.
firm.body: Optional IP so a district or brand keeps a face after the budget ends. Start with Woongdee, or commission one for your place.
firm.from: Grew from LOOK DOWN and the Woongdee short film
firm.alt: Woongdee looking up from a puddle on the floor
